Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: 1.4404 bar – volume commitment and indexed terms
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining the alloy, labour and processing components. I appreciate the transparency. The annual movements you cite deserve consideration, but the starting price should also reflect the more recent market evidence; please see the figures below.

Our annual requirement for this bar is fixed at 23,700 kg. Under the proposed term sheets, we would commit to that quantity bindingly. My preference is a 36-month agreement: it gives Werdenfels a firm volume commitment rather than a series of individual enquiries.

We propose €5.40 per kg for 36 months, with payment at 90 days net and an AS-14404 index clause covering a 45% material share, based on 2026-08, with a 5% deadband. We also submit a 24-month package at €5.40 per kg with the same payment and index terms.

This combines dependable volume for you with a transparent mechanism for alloy movements. Please review the packages against your calculation and let us know whether the longer commitment supports agreement on these terms.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

Our offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen

strategy:
Supplier: Blankstahl Werdenfels (family stainless bar stockholder, inside sales desk, owner in background). Public notes:
three meeting notes say its sales director is "reviewing small accounts and will focus on customers with volume";
price changes above 2% need its pricing committee (meets every two weeks); the owner offered to walk us through
their calculation. Past exchanges: it insists on an AS-14404 index clause for a 24-month term, accepts 90-day payment,
and asks "Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data." when we state things without IDs.
Plan: ROUND 1 - state truthfully that our annual requirement for this bar is fixed at 23,700 kg and that we commit
to it bindingly, and offer the longest commitment (36 months = 71,100 kg total) as THE thing we bring for a volume-focused
partner; send sheets with the index clause deadband 5 at 36 months and at 24 months, deep (L6-L7), 90 days; include the
AS-14404 index fall claim (one claim only). ROUND 2 - thank it for what it accepted, add the PPI-C2431 fall claim (one
claim), ask it explicitly to take the package to its pricing committee because the step we ask exceeds 2%, move one
level toward it (never repeat a sheet, always stay below its standing offer). ROUND 3 - add the purchase-order history
claim, move a little, ask for its best committee-approved price on the 36-month package. ROUND 4-5 - converge; code
accepts when it agrees or goes final. Tone: warm, concrete, partner-like, short. Never mention any other supplier or quote.

out.subject: Bar supply agreement – remaining price adjustment
out.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for incorporating the verified processing-price data and confirming payment at 90 days net with the 36-month commitment. That resolves the payment point. I also understand that you do not share further detail on your cost structure; we need not reopen that discussion.

With the commercial framework settled, I propose €5.47 per kg under the attached term sheet. It retains the binding annual quantity of 23,700 kg for 36 months, payment at 90 days net and the AS-14404 index clause covering a 45% material share, with base month 2026-08 and a 5% deadband.

For the remaining price review, please also consider our purchase-order history below. It documents the existing business behind the longer volume commitment, alongside the market evidence you have already verified.

Please put this package to your pricing committee and confirm its best approved price on that basis. We are keeping the agreed payment and index terms unchanged so the review can focus on the starting price.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

Thank you for the constructive discussion and for accommodating the longer-term arrangement.
